essence: Sweet speech ravishing thought, seer and seen: the conqueror whose greatness is manifest bliss.

sections.SUMMARY: Honeyed lips ravish thought; seen and seer meet; the bliss-manifest great Lord triumphs — high God.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder at manifest greatness)
rasa.justification: Maṅgala opening: speech ravishing, mutual seeing, triumph proclaimed; wonder at greatness resolving into devotion.

essence: Undefeated conqueror grown great with auspicious wealth, knowledge-lit.
Milk-ocean Śaṅkara bowed; hate and praise both address Ambikā's husband who holds the all.
Vast Śambhu of withdrawn touch and full nectar; all-common supreme form undivided in division.
Sthāṇu beyond minute and great; goose-power praised; groundless world-picture bowed.
Milked stainless Śiva-wisdom begged; offering carried to undivided Bhava, ultimate truth's one being.

sections.SUMMARY: The undefeated conquers in auspicious wealth. Śaṅkara the milk-ocean receives homage; hatred and hymn alike reach Ambikā's husband holding all. Vast Śambhu wears withdrawn touch and full nectar; the all-common Lord stays whole in fracture. Sthāṇu spans mote and cosmos; the goose-power spreads wings over the egg; the picture blooms wall-less. Wisdom milked stainless from illusion's waters is begged for; the offering rests with undivided Bhava, one with the ultimate real.

rasa.justification: Each epithet widens the Lord (wealth, ocean, vastness, egg, milk); wonder at scale carried as praise-offering.

essence: Longing to see the deep and dwell in the cave; homage to dream-seers of the bliss-giver.
Desire to contemplate being cuts rebirth-fear; lifelong single-pointed staying resolved.
Veda-bodied wish-tree bowed; entrusting all acts to become you-made and pair-free.
Independent trident power in all cosmic tasks; Dhūrjaṭi's name outdoes meditations.
Mantra refuge praised; every path, word, meditation is the Lord.

sections.SUMMARY: The deep calls to be seen and dwelt in; those who glimpse the moon-crested even asleep earn homage. Hunger to brood on being severs rebirth dread; lifelong one-pointedness is vowed. The Veda-bodied granter bends low; handing over deed, speech, mind, the lover turns you-stuffed and quarrel-free. Alone-working spear-power orders birth and close; one Name outweighs all props. Mantra-sheltered strivers win praise; road, utterance, trance alike end in the Lord.

rasa.dominant: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)
rasa.justification: Hunger to see and stay (deep, cave, tree, name) settling into praise; longing fixed one-pointed.

essence: Rasa of worship-meditation-pleasure swells thousandfold in the Lord.
Remembrance alone cures ignorance-darkness; homage itself belongs to Īśa the fulfiller.
Devotion-jewel fished from the dread sea conquers all; few know the veiled knowable.
Qualityless one known of the knowing, desireless fruit of wants, conquers unborn.
Milk-sea fortune natural to the Lord alone; the blossomer gives bliss in being and non-being.
All-knowing, all-doing, all: nothing left but endless offering.

sections.SUMMARY: Tended worship swells thousand-streamed. One recall heals blackout; the bow itself is already his. Fished from terror waters, love's gem buys everything; the open secret stays hid from most. Want-free and trait-free, the Unborn wins and rewards. Sea-churned riches sit easy on him only; he blooms for release, shields in life and lifelessness, and, all-wise, all-working, all, takes all in endless due.

rasa.dominant: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
rasa.justification: Worship given, grace returned: medicine, jewel, milk, refuge, endless due.
